title: UI polish T8: create button grows into a panel
description: Plain CSS morph; owner answer 1: list every existing template under its current name, then Import a file... and Recover from a project.json file...; remove the two text links (plan T8). Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-ui-polish/PLAN.md exactly (its section for this task: Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, plus the five answered Open questions). Protocol: serial check slot via files add before expensive checks, pinned Node, quoted --outDir, no installs, no commits, status CLAIMED, independent review required.

review.note: APPROVED (CLAIMED, not VERIFIED; owner hand check still needed). Reviewer agent-46ab (Claude Code, Opus). Code: items/order match answer 1 (Blank, Essay, Chicago student paper, Screenplay, Story, saved templates, separator, 'Import a file…', 'Recover from a project.json file…'); both file items call .click() on the EXISTING #import-writing-text / #import-project-json inputs whose accept lists, onChange handlers (onImportWriting / onImport) and reset are byte-identical to the old rows, so same caps, same Import writing dialog, same recover flow, no new code path; inputs + visually hidden labels (#import-writing-label text unchanged, #import-project-label) stay mounted inside main.library (placed after the damaged region rather than 'just inside' main; harmless). Old .import rows gone; grep -rn 'create-menu|import-choose|className="import"' src tests -> nothing; no .import CSS selector remains. role=group is exactly plan T8 step 2, so the worker's 'DEVIATION' label is wrong: it is not a deviation. Trigger: one <button> 'Start new project', aria-expanded + aria-controls=create-panel. Keyboard: Enter/Space via native button click, useLayoutEffect focuses first item, Arrow Up/Down wrap, Home/End, Escape closes + refocuses trigger (stopPropagation), outside pointerdown closes (Dropdown pattern), Tab-out closes via onBlur relatedTarget (implemented, no spec case). Morph: plain CSS clip-path inset from --trigger-w/--trigger-h (measured on click) to inset(0) via @starting-style, var(--duration-morph) var(--ease-spring), items fade in, closing instant, global reduced-motion transition:none; outer filter: drop-shadow is a CSS filter (no SVG filter); square corners; colours are tokens; a few raw non-token literals (220px min-width, 6px 18px shadow copied from dropdown.css, 60ms item delay, -2px focus offset) pass designTokens. z-index 9/8 sits below dropdown (40) and modal backdrop (70). Hint text change has no forbidden punctuation. Native harnesses native-smoke.js:162-168, native-reliability.js:88-93, native-screens.js:115-119 match buttons by exact trimmed text 'Start new project' then 'Blank'; still compatible. Fail-first: ui-t8/failfirst.log 9 failed / 5 passed on pre-T8 build; outside-click passed vacuously there and the spec now asserts toBeVisible() before clicking outside (spec :122; log line numbers shift by one, confirming the insertion; its failure on pre-T8 is inferred, not rerun). Reruns (pinned Node v22.23.3, logs in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui-t8-review/): tsc --noEmit exit 0; npm test serial 50 files / 889 tests passed; Playwright against ui-t8/dist (dist newer than every src file) via a cloned config on port 1577 (1576 was free; cloned so the worker's report stays intact), 1 worker, 0 retries: projects-screen 14, import 3, import-cancel 5, rich-import 7, features 6, appearance 13, accessibility 4, layout 6, housekeeping 4 = 62/62 passed. Native: smoke rebuild (npm run build ran first, vite built, cargo exit 0, binary 00:15:41) then scripts/native-screens.py exit 0, 8 PNGs in ui-t8-review/native: projects-light/dark show new header (magnifier, Sort, blue 'Start new project' button), 'No projects yet.', NO import/recover links; writing-light/dark, research-light/dark, settings-light/dark render normally; the harness then clicked 'Start new project' -> 'Blank' and reached the title field in WKWebView, so the panel's Blank path works natively. Morph in WebKit: this Mac is macOS 15.7.9 with Safari 26.6.1 / system WebKit 20621 (not Safari 18 as the brief assumed); library.css uses only @starting-style + a clip-path transition between two inset() shapes, no transition-behavior: allow-discrete; @starting-style has shipped in WebKit since Safari 17.5, so the morph is expected to animate in WKWebView. Fallback if it does not is 'the panel just appears' (acceptable per plan). Shots: all six ui-t8/shots viewed: square corners, panel anchored at the button's top-left, no caption, focus ring on Blank, old links gone; dark Color variant shows the blue fill trigger (light Plain and Color look alike because both accents are blue). git status: every change maps to T071-T079/T084; scripts/__pycache__/ is bytecode from running native-screens.py. UNPROVEN: mid-morph frames in either engine (only settled states captured), the open panel in native WebKit (harness captures closed state only), native file pickers opened from 'Import a file…' / 'Recover…' in WKWebView, Tab-out close (no test), native-smoke.js and native-reliability.js not run. Owner hand check: open the app, click Start new project, watch the panel grow from the button; try Import a file… and Recover from a project.json file…; turn on Reduce Motion and confirm it opens instantly.
